Install the approved Workforce update before submitting work-time, request or device changes.
If this phone is lost or replaced, promptly ask an authorized administrator to revoke or replace its enrollment. Removing the app does not revoke the server enrollment.
Before planned removal, refresh Recovery first. Signing out or uninstalling deletes this phone’s encrypted session, private key and pending local outbox; those local items cannot be restored.
A trusted device signs only the exact work-time action you confirm. The Android system performs biometric matching; Workforce never receives a template or result.
